description.text: Elementary, Intermediate and Advanced Classes are offered over summer vacation.Placement is done in accordance to the students' levels of Chinese.Each class is set up with as few students as possible for the purpose of accelerating the students' Chinese studies within a short term. The 6 weeks program is from July.16-Aug.24 . Students can choose 2-6 weeks of the program . According to students' Chinese proficiency , the program will divide into different levels of classes . The tuition fee is 500 RMB / week.

duration.text: The Summer Vacation Class at Liaoning University is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 69 USD/per week ￥ 500 CNY/per week

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant
